ns2:course.label: Obstetrics
ns2:course.description: Topics include normal delivery, breach, multiple gestation, medical illness of pregnancy – diabetes, placenta previa. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Restricted to students enrolled in the MD program at Carle Illinois College of Medicine.
